title: Your Rights and Responsibilities
about: What patients can expect from the clinic, and what the clinic asks of them. Give it at the first visit and post it.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.text: At {facility.name}, you have the right to:
• Be treated with respect, kindness and fairness.
• Have your health information kept private.
• Get information about your health and care in words you understand.
• Have an interpreter or help with reading if you need it.
• Take part in decisions about your care.
• Say yes or no to any test or treatment.
• Know the names of the people who care for you.
• Ask for another opinion.
• See your health record and get a copy.
• Know about costs before your care when we can tell you.
• Make a complaint, by telling any of our staff or in writing, and get an answer, without being treated differently.
We ask you to:
• Tell us the truth about your health, your medicines and your past care.
• Tell us when your address, phone or insurance changes.
• Follow the care plan you agree to, or tell us if you cannot.
• Come to your visits, or call us if you cannot.
• Treat staff and other patients with respect.
• Pay your bills, or talk with us about a payment plan or a discount if paying is hard.
• Ask questions when you do not understand.
Questions or concerns? Ask at the front desk or call {facility.phone}.
